title: Seymour Cray's Only Surviving Talk: "Cray-1 Introduction" (1976, LANL)
summary: Seymour Cray's only surviving recorded talk, introducing the Cray-1 supercomputer in 1976. He describes the machine's design, including its vector architecture and cooling through the frame.
why: Cited as a rare first-hand account from Cray, loved for details like the aluminum machining invented to carry Freon through the frame.

quote.text: My favorite part is his description of the aluminum machining they had to invent in order to move the freon through the frame
